src: A copy of the redone Restock legs with no suspension included
zh: Restock重制版着陆支架的副本，移除了悬挂结构

src: Take Command enhances the External Command Seat so you can now assign crew to it from within the VAB/SPH just like any other command module. Just add one or more command seats to your ship, assign crew as usual, and launch! Your Kerbal crew will automatically spawn and jump into their assigned seats.
zh: Take Command 增强了外部指挥座椅的功能，使你现在可以像对其他指令舱一样，直接在 VAB/SPH 内为其分配乘员。只需在飞船上添加一个或多个指挥座椅，照常分配乘员并启动发射，坎巴拉乘员就会自动生成并坐上指定的座椅。

src: Freshly imported from an interstellar race with no Prime Directive, Prakasa is a pack aimed at aircraft and spaceplanes, namely with the objective of filling the 2.5 meter void between the diminutive Mk2 and massive Mk3. The parts are themed towards a somewhat more distant future than stock, offering greater interior space and a cleaner, spaceship-er aesthetic.
zh: 刚从一个没有最高指导原则的星际种族那里进口，Prakasa 是一个面向飞机和空天飞机的部件包，主要目的是填补小巧的 Mk2 与庞大的 Mk3 之间 2.5 米规格的空白。这些部件的设计风格比原版更偏向遥远的未来，提供更大的内部空间和更简洁、更具飞船感的审美。
